system.description:
Your armor is fitted with a compact nanogram projector which can generate short-lived barriers of force, electroshock fields, and bright holographic displays. Such technology is complex, with many secrets, and you’ve been entrusted with the code-phrases and activator-words to control this technology… but also the knowledge that its signals may draw unwanted attention.

You may activate your Nanobarrier at the start of any action, choosing one of the following options:

  • Barrier: Add +1 to the Difficulty of attacks against you or one nearby ally until the start of your next action.

  • Shock: Until the start of your next action, anyone who fails a melee attack against you suffers a shocked 2 Injury.

  • Display: Until the start of your next turn, any NPC attacking someone other than you must spend 1 Threat to do so.

The first time you use this ability in a scene, it is free. The second time, it costs 1 Threat. Each time after the second, increase the cost by +1 Threat.
